G0760.def:
**Ἀσάφ**, ὁ indecl. (Heb. אָסַף), [H609]
Asaph, an obvious error for Ἀσά, found in the best texts, and adopted by LTTr. and WH, R, mg.: [[Mat.1.7-8|Mat.1:7-8]]†
(AS)

G0792.def:
**ἀστήρ**, -έρος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for כּוֹכָב ;]
**a star**: [[Mat.2.2, 7-10|Mat.2:2, 7-10]] :, [[Mrk.13.25|Mrk.13:25]], [[1Co.15.41|1Co.15:41]], [[Rev.6.13; 8.10-12; 9.1; 12.1, 4|Rev.6:13 8:10-12 9:1 12:1, 4]]; metaphorically, ὁ ἀ. ὁ πρωϊνός [[Rev.2.28; 22.16|Rev.2:28 22:16]]; ἀ. πλαῆται, [[Jude.13|Ju 13]]; ἀ. ἑπτά, symbolizing the angels of the seven churches, [[Rev.1.16, 20; 2.1; 3.1|Rev.1:16, 20 2:1 3:1]] (cf. ἄστρον, and see _DCG_, ii, 674 f.; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0749.def:
**ἀρχιερεύς**, -έως, ὁ,
[in LXX for כּ'' הָרֹאשׁ,כּ'' הַגָּדוֹל ,כּהֵן ;]
1. **high-priest**: [[Mrk.2.26; 14.47|Mrk.2:26 14:47]], al.; of Christ: [[Heb.2.17; 3.1|Heb.2:17 3:1]], al.
2. In pl., **chief priests**, including ex-high-priests and members of high-priestly families: [[Mat.2.4|Mat.2:4]], [[Mrk.8.31|Mrk.8:31]], al. (Cremer, 294; _DCG_, i, 297f.; MM, see word).
(AS)

G0745.def:
**Ἀρχέλαος**, -ου, ὁ
**Archelaus, son of Herod the Great, King of Judma, Samaria and Idumæa**: [[Mat.2.22|Mat.2:22]]†
(AS)

G0762.def:
**ἄ-σβεστος**, -ον
(σβέννυμι), [in LXX for נָפַח לֹא, [[Job.20.26|Job.20:26]] א3 A (ἄκαυστον, א2 B)* ;]
**unquenched, unquenchable**: πῦρ, [[Mat.3.12|Mat.3:12]], [[Mrk.9.43|Mrk.9:43]], [[Luk.3.17|Luk.3:17]].†
(AS)

G0737.def:
**ἄρτι **
_adv._, [in LXX: Dan LXX 9:22 10:11 (עַתָּה), al. ;]
_adv._,
**of coincidence, denoting strictly present time, as contrasted with past or future, just, just now, this moment**: [[Mat.3.15; 9.18; 26.53|Mat.3:15 9:18 26:53]], [[Jhn.13.7|Jhn.13:7]], [[Gal.4.20|Gal.4:20]], [[1Th.3.6|1Th.3:6]] (see Lft., _Notes_, 44; Milligan, in l), [[Rev.12.10|Rev.12:10]] opposite to past time, [[Jhn.9.19, 25; 13.33|Jhn.9:19, 25 13:33]], [[1Co.16.7|1Co.16:7]], [[Gal.1.9-10|Gal.1:9-10]]; to future, [[Jhn.13.37; 16.12, 31|Jhn.13:37 16:12, 31]], [[1Co.13.12|1Co.13:12]], [[2Th.2.7|2Th.2:7]], [[1Pe.1.6; 1.8|1Pe.1:6 1:8]]; ἄχρι τῆς ἅ. ὥρας, [[1Co.4.11|1Co.4:11]] ἕως ἄ., [[Mat.11.12|Mat.11:12]], [[Jhn.2.10; 5.17; 16.24|Jhn.2:10 5:17 16:24]], [[1Co.4.13; 8.7; 15.6|1Co.4:13 8:7 15:6]], [[1Jn.2.9|1Jn.2:9]]; ἀπ᾽ ἄ., see: ἀπάρτι (see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 70 f; MM, see word).†
_SYN._: νῦν, now, "the objective, immediate present; ἤδη, now, already, " the subjective present, with a suggested reference to some other time or to some expectation". (Thayer, 75.) (AS)

G0740.def:
**ἄρτος**, -ου, ὁ,
[in LXX chiefly for לֶחֶם ;]
**bread, a loaf**: [[Mat.4.3|Mat.4:3]], 4 [[Mrk.3.20|Mrk.3:20]], al.; ἄρτοι τ. προθέσεως, **bread of the setting forth**, i.e. the shewbread. Metaphorical, ὁ ἄ. τ. θεοῦ, τ. ζωῆς, ref. to Christ, [[Jhn.6.33, 35|Jhn.6:33, 35]]; in general, **food**: [[Mat.6.11|Mat.6:11]], al.; ἄ. φαγεῖν (Heb. אֲכֹל לֶחֶם), **to eat** (MM, see word), [[Luk.14.1|Lu 14:1]], al.
(AS)

G0744.def:
**ἀρχαῖος**, -αία, -αῖον
(ἀρχή), [in LXX chiefly for קֶדֶם ;]
**original, ancient**: [[Mat.5.21, 33|Mat.5:21, 33]], [[Luk.9.8, 19|Luk.9:8, 19]], [[Act.15.7, 21; 21.16|Act.15:7, 21 21:16]], [[2Co.5.17|2Co.5:17]], [[2Pe.2.5|2Pe.2:5]], [[Rev.12.9; 20.2|Rev.12:9 20:2]].†
_SYN._: παλαιός, old, without the reference to beginning and origin contained in ἀ. The distinction is observed in π. (MM, see word). ἀ. is the antithesis to καινός: παλ. to vέος (see Westc., He., 223; Cremer, 116) (AS)

G0782.def:
**ἀσπάζομαι ** depon.,
[in LXX: [[Ezk.18.7|Eze.18:7]], [[Jdg.18.15|Jdg.18:15]] (שָׁלוֹם שָׁאַל), [[Est.5.2|Est.5:2]], [[1Ma.7.29|1Ma.7:29]], al. ;]
**to welcome, greet, salute**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.5.47|Mat.5:47]], [[Mrk.9.15|Mrk.9:15]], [[Act.21.7|Act.21:7]], al.; id. before ἐν φιλήματι, [[Rom.16.16|Rom.16:16]], [[1Co.16.20|1Co.16:20]], [[2Co.13.12|2Co.13:12]], [[1Th.5.26|1Th.5:26]], [[1Pe.5.14|1Pe.5:14]]; τ. ἐκκλησίαν (Deiss., BS, 257), [[Act.18.22|Act.18:22]] as term. tech. for conveying greetings at the end of a letter (MM, see word), used by an amanuensis (Milligan, _NTD_, 23), [[Rom.16.22|Rom.16:22]] (on the aoristic Pres., here and elsewhere, see M, _Pr._, 119; Bl., § 56, 4); κατήντησαν . . . ἀσπασάμενοι (on this constr., see El., § 58, 4; M, _Pr._, 132, 238), [[Act.25.13|Act.25:13]] (cf. ἀπ-ἀπ-ασπάζομαι).†
(AS)

G0710.def:
**ἀριστερός**, -ά, -όν
[in LXX for שְׂמֹאול ;]
**left, on the left**: ὅπλα, [[2Co.6.7|2Co.6:7]] ἡ ἀ.. (sc. χείρ), [[Mat.6.3|Mat.6:3]] ἐξ ἀριστερῶν, **on the left **(MM, see word ): [[Mrk.10.37|Mrk.10:37]], [[Luk.23.33|Luk.23:33]].†
(AS)

G0713.def:
**ἀρκετός**, -ή, -όν
(ἀρκέω), [in Aq.: [[Deu.25.2|Deu.25:2]] * ;]
**sufficient**: [[Mat.6.34|Mat.6:34]] (on the neut., see B1., § 31, 2); before ἵνα (M, _Pr._, 210), [[Mat.10.25|Mat.10:25]] with inf., [[1Pe.4.3|1Pe.4:3]] (for exx., see Deiss., BS, 257; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0727.def:
**ἅρπαξ**, -αγος, ὁ, ἡ
(ἁρπάζω), [in LXX: [[Gen.49.27|Gen.49:27]] (טָרַף) * ;]
**rapacious**: [[Mat.7.15|Mat.7:15]], [[Luk.18.11|Luk.18:11]]; as subst., a swindler, an extortioner (MM, see word), [[1Co.5.10-11; 6.10|1Co.5:10-11 6:10]].†
(AS)

G0779.def:
**ἀσκός**, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX for חֵמֶת, נֹאד, נֶבֶל ;]
**a leather bottle, wine-skin**: [[Mat.9.17|Mat.9:17]], [[Mrk.2.22|Mrk.2:22]], [[Luk.5.37-38|Luk.5:37-38]].†
(AS)

G0787.def:
**ἀσσάριον**, -ον, τό
(diminutive of Lat. as),
**an assarion, a farthing, one-tenth of a drachma**: [[Mat.10.29|Mat.10:29]], [[Luk.12.6|Luk.12:6]] (MM, see word; _DB_, iii, 428; _DCG_, ii, 200).†
(AS)

G0705.def:
**ἀριθμέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for סָפַר pi., פָּקַד pi., etc. ;]
**to number **(esp. for payment, MM, see word): [[Mat.10.30|Mat.10:30]], [[Luk.12.7|Luk.12:7]], [[Rev.7.9|Rev.7:9]].†
(AS)

G0720.def:
**ἀρνέομαι** -οῦμαι, depon.,
[in LXX: [[Gen.18.15|Gen.18:15]] (כָּחַשׁ pi.), [[Wis.12.27; 16.16; 17.10|Wis.12:27 16:16 17:10]], [[4Ma.8.7|4Ma.8:7]] [[4Mac.10.15|4Mac 10:15]] * ;]
1. to deny, say no, opposite to είπεῖν: absol., [[Mat.26.70|Mat.26:70]], [[Luk.8.45|Luk.8:45]]; before ἅτι, [[1Jn.2.22|1Jn.2:22]] with inf., [[Heb.11.24|Heb.11:24]]
2. In late Gk. (MM, see word), with accusative of person(s), **to deny, refuse to acknowledge, disown**: [[Act.3.14; 7.35|Act.3:14 7:35]]; Ἰησοῦν, [[Mat.10.33|Mat.10:33]], [[2Ti.2.12|2Ti.2:12]], [[1Jn.2.22|1Jn.2:22]], [[Jude.4|Ju 4]]; ἑαυτόν, [[Luk.9.23|Luk.9:23]], [[2Ti.2.13|2Ti.2:13]] (prove false to)
3. C. accusative of thing(s) (in cl. to refuse), **to deny, abjure**: [[1Ti.5.8|1Ti.5:8]], [[Tit.2.12|Tit.2:12]], [[2Ti.3.5|2Ti.3:5]] (cf. ἀπαρνέομαι)
(AS)

G0726.def:
**ἁρπάζω **
[in LXX chiefly for גָּזַל, טָרַף ;]
**to seize, catch up, snatch away, carry off by force**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.12.29; 13.19|Mat.12:29 13:19]], [[Jhn.10.12, 28-29|Jhn.10:12, 28-29]]; τ. βασιλείαν τ. θεοῦ, [[Mat.11.12|Mat.11:12]] with accusative of person(s), [[Jhn.6.15|Jhn.6:15]], [[Act.8.39; 23.10|Act.8:39 23:10]], [[Jude.23|Ju 23]]; pass., before ἕως, [[2Co.12.2|2Co.12:2]] εἰς, [[2Co.12.4|2Co.12:4]], [[1Th.4.17|1Th.4:17]]; πρός, [[Rev.12.5|Rev.12:5]] (cf. δι-, συν-αρπάζω, and see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0700.def:
**ἀρέσκω **
[in LXX chiefly for טוֹב ;]
1. **to please **(Hom., Hdt., al.): with dative of person(s), [[Mat.14.6|Mat.14:6]], [[Mrk.6.22|Mrk.6:22]], [[Rom.8.8; 15.2|Rom.8:8 15:2]], [[1Th.2.15; 4.1|1Th.2:15 4:1]], [[1Co.7.32-34|1Co.7:32-34]] [[Gal.1.10|Gal.1:10]], [[2Ti.2.4|2Ti.2:4]]; before ἐνώπισν (= _Heb._ בּעֵנֵי, Bl., § 37, 1; 40, 7), Ac 65.
2. In late Gk., esp. in Inscr., to render service to (see M, _Th._, _ICC_, 1 Co., ll with; Cremer, 640 f.); [[Rom.15.1|Rom.15:1]], 3, [[1Co.10.33|1Co.10:33]], [[1Th.2.4|1Th.2:4]].†
(AS)

G0746.def:
**ἀρχή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX for קֶדֶם, רֹאשׁ, רֹאשׁ, etc. ;]
1. **beginning, origin**;
(a) absol., of the beginning of all things: of God as the Eternal, the First Cause, [[Rev.21.6|Rev.21:6]] (cf. 18); similarly, of Christ, [[Rev.22.13|Rev.22:13]] of Christ as the uncreated principle, the active cause of creation, [[Rev.3.14|Rev.3:14]] in his relation to the Church, [[Col.1.18|Col.1:18]] ἐν ἀ., [[Jhn.1.1-2;|Jhn.1:1-2]] ἀπ᾽ ἀ. (and ἀπ᾽ ἀ. κτισεως), [[Mat.19.4, 8; 24.21|Mat.19:4, 8 24:21]], [[Mrk.10.6; 13.19|Mrk.10:6 13:19]], [[Jhn.8.44|Jhn.8:44]], [[2Th.2.13|2Th.2:13]], [[2Pe.3.4|2Pe.3:4]], [[1Jn.1.1|1Jn.1:1]] [[Jhn.2.13-14|Jn 2:13-14]] [[Jhn.2.24|Jn 2:24]]; κατ ἀρχἀς, [[Heb.1.10|Heb.1:10]]
(b) **relatively**: [[Heb.7.3|Heb.7:3]] ἀ. ὠδίνων, [[Mat.24.8|Mat.24:8]], [[Mrk.13.9|Mrk.13:9]]; τ. σημείων, [[Jhn.2.11|Jhn.2:11]] τ. ὑποστάσεως, [[Heb.3.14|Heb.3:14]] τ. λογίων, [[Heb.5.12|Heb.5:12]] ὁ τ. ἀρχῆς τ. Χριστοῦ λόγος, the account of the beginning, the elementary view of Christ, [[Heb.6.1|Heb.6:1]] ἀρχὴν λαμβάνειν, to begin, [[Heb.2.3|Heb.2:3]] ἐξ ἀ., [[Jhn.6.64; 16.4|Jhn.6:64 16:4]]; ἀπ᾽ ἀ., [[Luk.1.2|Luk.1:2]], [[Jhn.15.27|Jhn.15:27]], [[1Jn.2.7|1Jn.2:7]] [[Jhn.2.24|Jn 2:24]] [[Jhn.3.11|Jn 3:11]], [[2Jn.5-6|2Jn.5-6]]; ἐν ἀ., [[Act.11.15; 26.4|Act.11:15 26:4]], [[Php.4.15|Php.4:15]]; τὴν ἀρχήν, adverbially, **at all **(Hdt., al.; v MM, see word): [[Jhn.8.25|Jhn.8:25]]
2. **an extremity, a corner**: [[Act.10.11; 11.5|Act.10:11 11:5]].
3. **sovereignty, principality, rule **(cf. _DB_, i, 616 f.): [[Luk.12.11; 20.20|Luk.12:11 20:20]], [[Rom.8.38|Rom.8:38]], [[1Co.15.24|1Co.15:24]], [[Eph.1.21; 3.10; 6.12|Eph.1:21 3:10 6:12]], [[Col.1.16; 2.10, 15|Col.1:16 2:10, 15]] [[Tit.3.1|Tit.3:1]], [[Jude.6|Ju 6]] (Cremer, 113).†
(AS)

G0730.def:
**ἄρσην** (ἄρρην, T, in [[Rom.1.27|Rom.1:27]] Rec. in [[Rev.12.5, 13|Rev.12:5, 13]]) -ενος, ὁ, ἡ, ἄρσεν, τό
(old Attic for ἄρρην, see supr.; both forms are found in π.; MM, see word), [in LXX chiefly for זָכָר ;]
**male**: [[Mat.19.4|Mat.19:4]], [[Mrk.10.6|Mrk.10:6]], [[Luk.2.23|Luk.2:23]], [[Rom.1.27|Rom.1:27]], [[Gal.3.28|Gal.3:28]], [[Rev.12.5, 13|Rev.12:5, 13]].†
(AS)

G0712.def:
**ἄριστον**, -ου, τό
[in LXX: [[1Ki.3.1|3Ki.3:1]] (לֶחֶם), [[Tob.2.1|Tob.2:1]], 4, al. ;]
1 1, prop., breakfast.
2. In late Gk. = cl. δεῖτνον, **dinner**: [[Mat.22.4|Mat.22:4]], [[Luk.11.38; 14.12|Luk.11:38 14:12]].†
(AS)

G0724.def:
**ἁρπαγή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἁρπάζω), [in LXX (as also ἅρπαγμα) for גָּזֵל, etc. ;]
**pillage, plundering, robbery**: [[Mat.23.25|Mat.23:25]], [[Luk.11.39|Luk.11:39]], [[Heb.10.34|Heb.10:34]].†
(AS)

G0714.def:
**ἀρκέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX for הוֹן, etc. ;]
1. **to keep off**; with dative, to assist.
2. **to suffice**: with dative of person(s), Jo 67, [[2Co.12.9|2Co.12:9]] impers., [[Mat.25.9|Mat.25:9]], [[Jhn.14.8|Jhn.14:8]] (MM, see word). Pass., **to be satisfied**: with dative of thing(s), [[Luk.3.14|Luk.3:14]], [[1Ti.6.8|1Ti.6:8]], [[Heb.13.5|Heb.13:5]]; before ἐπί, [[3Jn.10|III Jn 10]].†
(AS)

G0772.def:
**ἀσθενής -ές**
(ἀ- neg., σθένος, strength), [in LXX for עָנִי, etc. ;]
**without strength, weak, feeble**: [[1Co.1.27; 4.10; 12.22|1Co.1:27 4:10 12:22]], [[2Co.10.10|2Co.10:10]], [[Gal.4.9|Gal.4:9]], [[1Th.5.14|1Th.5:14]], [[Heb.7.18|Heb.7:18]], [[1Pe.3.7|1Pe.3:7]]. Rhetorically, τό ἀ. τ. θεοῦ, God's action of apparent weakness: [[1Co.1.25|1Co.1:25]] of bodily debility, **sick, sickly**: [[Mat.25.39|Mat.25:39]] (Rec.) [[Mat.25.43-44|Mat.25:43-44]], [[Luk.9.2|Luk.9:2]] (Rec.) [[Luk.10.9|Luk.10:9]], [[Act.4.9; 5.15-16|Act.4:9 5:15-16]] In moral and spiritual sense (MM, see word; Cremer, 526), [[Mat.26.41|Mat.26:41]], [[Mrk.14.38|Mrk.14:38]], [[Rom.5.6|Rom.5:6]], [[1Co.8.7; 8.9-10; 9.22; 11.30|1Co.8:7 8:9-10 9:22 11:30]].†
(AS)

G0752.def:
**ἀρχισυνάγωγος**, -ου, ὁ
(συναγωγή),
**ruler of a synagogue, an administrative officer, supervising the worship **(הַכְּנֵםֶת רֹאשׁ): [[Mrk.5.22, 35-36; 5.38|Mrk.5:22, 35-36 5:38]] [[Luk.8.49; 13.14|Luk.8:49 13:14]], [[Act.13.15; 18.8, 17|Act.13:15 18:8, 17]] (Inscr., see MM, see word; cf. also _DB_, _ext._, 101).†
(AS)

G0766.def:
**ἀσέλγεια**, -ας, ἡ
(ἀσελγής, licentious; see MM, see word), [in LXX: [[Wis.14.26|Wis.14:26]], [[3Ma.2.26|3Ma.2:26]] * ;]
**licentiousness, wantonness, excess**: [[Mrk.7.22|Mrk.7:22]], [[Rom.13.13|Rom.13:13]], [[2Co.12.21|2Co.12:21]], [[Gal.5.19|Gal.5:19]] (Lft., in l), [[Eph.4.19|Eph.4:19]], [[1Pe.4.3|1Pe.4:3]], [[2Pe.2.2; 2.7; 2.18|2Pe.2:2 2:7 2:18]], [[Jude.4|Ju 4]].†
_SYN._: ἀσωτία, profligacy, prodigality (see Tr., _Syn._, § xvi; _DB_, iii, 46). (AS)

G0741.def:
**ἀρτύω **
[in Sm.: [[Sng.8.2|Sng.8:2]] * ;]
1. to arrange, make ready (Hom.).
2. Of food (as in comic writers), **to season **(MM, see word): [[Mrk.9.50|Mrk.9:50]], [[Luk.14.34|Luk.14:34]], [[Col.4.6|Col.4:6]].†
(AS)

G0723.def:
**ἄροτρον**, -ου, τό
(ἀρόω, to plough), [in LXX chiefly for אֵת ;]
**a plough**: [[Luk.9.62|Luk.9:62]]†
(AS)

G0704.def:
**ἀρήν**, ἀρνός, ὁ
(nom, not in use, exc. in early times: see MM, see word), [in LXX for מְרִיא, כֶּבֶשׂ, etc. ;]
**a lamb**: [[Luk.10.3|Luk.10:3]]†
(AS)

G0722.def:
**ἀροτριάω**, -ῶ
(ἄροτρον), [in LXX: [[Deu.22.10|Deu.22:10]], al. (חָרַשׁ), [[Isa.7.25|Isa.7:25]] (עֲדַר) ;]
**later form of ἀρόω, to plough **(MM, see word): [[Luk.17.7|Luk.17:7]], [[1Co.9.10|1Co.9:10]].†
(AS)

G0797.def:
**ἀστράπτω **
[in LXX for בָּרָק ;]
**to lighten, flash forth**: [[Luk.17.24; 24.4|Luk.17:24 24:4]] (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0798.def:
**ἄστρον**, -ου, τό
[in LXX chiefly for כּוֹכָב ;]
(a) mostly in pl. (as in cl.), **the stars**: [[Luk.21.25|Luk.21:25]], [[Act.27.20|Act.27:20]], [[Heb.11.12|Heb.11:12]];
(b) in sing. (Xen., al.), only of some noted star; the symbol or image of a star, [[Act.7.43|Act.7:43]] (cf. ἀστήρ, and see MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0755.def:
**ἀρχι-τρίκλινος**, -ου, ὁ
(τρί-κλινος or -ον, a room with three couches)
**the superintendent of a banquet, whose duty it was to arrange the tables and food **(_DB_, ii, 253): [[Jhn.2.8-9|Jhn.2:8-9]]†
(AS)

G0701.def:
**ἀρεστός**, -ή, -όν
(ἀρέσκω), [in LXX for יָשָׁר, etc. ;]
**pleasing, agreeable **(Hdt., Xen., and later writers; see Cremer, 641 f; MM, see word): with dative of person(s), [[Jhn.8.29|Jhn.8:29]], [[Act.12.3|Act.12:3]]; before ἐνώπιον, with genitive (Bl., § 37, 1; 40, 7), [[1Jn.3.22|1Jn.3:22]] ἀρεστόν ἐστιν, with accusative and inf (El., § 69, 5; 72, 5), [[Act.6.2|Act.6:2]]†
(AS)

G0721.def:
**ἀρνίον**, -ου, τό
(dimin. of ἀρήν; see MM, see word), [in LXX: [[Psa.114.4|Psa.114:4]], 6 (pl., צֹאן בֵּן), [[Jer.11.19|Jer.11:19]] (כֶּבֶשׂ), [[Jer.50.45|Jer.50:45]] (צָעִיר)* ;]
**a little lamb, a lamb**: [[Jhn.21.15|Jhn.21:15]], [[Rev.2.7|Rev.2:7]].†
(AS)

G0747.def:
**ἀρχηγός**, -όν
[in LXX for רֹאשׁ, נָשִׂיא etc. ;]
**beginning, originating**: more freq., as subst.;
1. **founder, author **(Lat. auchor; so some­times in π., see MM, see word; Milligan, _NTD_, 75): [[Act.3.15|Act.3:15]] (R, mg.), [[Heb.2.10|Heb.2:10]] (R, txt.; but see Westc., in l, and Page, Ac., l.with).
2. **prince, leader **(so in M_Gr._, see Kennedy, _Sources_, 153): [[Act.3.15|Act.3:15]] (R, txt.) [[Act.5.31|Act.5:31]], [[Heb.2.10|Heb.2:10]] (cf. R, mg.) 122 (Cremer, 117).†
(AS)

G0791.def:
**ἀστεῖος**, -ον
(ἄστυ, a city), [in LXX: [[Exo.2.2|Exo.2:2]] (טוֹב), [[Num.22.32|Num.22:32]] (οὐκ ἀ. יָרַט), [[Jdg.3.17|Jdg.3:17]] (בָּרִיא), [[Jdt.11.23|Jdth.11:23]], Dan LXX, [[Sus.1.7|Sus 1:7]], [[2Ma.6.23|2Ma.6:23]] * ;]
1. of the town.
2. (Like Lat. urbanus),
(a) **courteous, **
(b) elegant (in π., of clothing, MM, see word), comely, fair (as in Ex, l.with), [[Heb.11.23|Heb.11:23]], [[Act.7.20|Act.7:20]].†
(AS)

G0716.def:
**ἅρμα**, -τος, τό
(ἀραρίσκω, to join), [in LXX רָכַב ;]
**a chariot**: [[Act.8.28-29, 38|Act.8:28-29, 38]], [[Rev.9.9|Rev.9:9]].†
(AS)

G0735.def:
**Ἄρτεμις**, -ιδος, ἡ
Artemis, an Asiatic goddess, to be disting. from the Gk. goddess of the same name: [[Act.19.24, 27-28|Act.19:24, 27-28]]
(AS)

G0775.def:
**Ἀσιάρχης**, -ου, ὁ
**an Asiarch, one of ten officers elected by the various cities in the province of Asia whose duty it was to celebrate at their own charges the public games and festivals**: [[Act.19.31|Act.19:31]] (Strab., Inscr.; _DB_, see word).†
(AS)

G0774.def:
**Ἀσιαός**, -ή, -όν
**Asian, of Asia, Asiatic**; as subst., ὁ (οἱ) Ἀ.: [[Act.20.4|Act.20:4]]†
(AS)

G0789.def:
**Ἄσσος**, -ου
(also Ἀσσός, -οῦ), ή
Assos, a city on the E. coast of Asia Minor: [[Act.20.13-14|Act.20:13-14]] (see: ἆσσον).†
(AS)

G0767.def:
**ἄσημος**, -ον
(σῆμα, a mark), [in LXX: [[Gen.30.42|Gen.30:42]] (עָטַף), [[Job.42.11|Job.42:11]], [[3Ma.1.3|3Ma.1:3]] * ;]
without mark (in π. of an uncircumcised boy: Deiss., BS, 153; MM, see word). Metaphorical (MM, see word), **unknown, obscure**: litotes, οὐκ ἄ (Eur., al.), πόλις, [[Act.21.39|Act.21:39]]†
(AS)

G0778.def:
**ἀσκέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[2Ma.15.4|2Ma.15:4]] * ;]
1. to adorn (poët.).
2. to practise, exercise (Hdt., Xen.).
3. **to endeavour **(Xen., al.): with inf., [[Act.24.16|Act.24:16]]†
(AS)

G0788.def:
**ἆσσον** (Rec., after Vg., Ἄσσον),
_adv._ (compar. of ἄγχι, **near**),
**nearer**: [[Act.27.13|Act.27:13]] (RV, close in shore; see B1., § 11, 3; 44, 3; poets, Ion, and late prose).†
(AS)

G0776.def:
**ἀσιτία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἄσιτος),
**fasting, abstinence from food**: [[Act.27.21|Act.27:21]]†
_SYN._: νηστεία (MM, ut infr.) (AS)

G0777.def:
**ἄσιτος**, -ον
(ἀ- neg., σῖτος)
**fasting, without eating **(cf. MM, see word): [[Act.27.33|Act.27:33]]†
(AS)

G0736.def:
**ἀρτέμων**, -ωνος (Rec. -ονος), ὁ
(ἀρτάω, to fasten to),
**a fore-sail or top-sail**: [[Act.27.40|Act.27:40]] (see _DB_, _ext._, 366b, 399a; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0763.def:
**ἀσέβεια**, -ας, ἡ
(ἀσεβής), [in LXX for פֶּשַׁע, רֶשַׁע, etc. ;]
**ungodliness, impiety**: [[Rom.1.18; 11.26|Rom.1:18 11:26]], [[2Ti.2.16|2Ti.2:16]], [[Tit.2.12|Tit.2:12]]; ἔργα ἀσεβείας, ungodly deeds, [[Jude.15|Ju 15]]; ἐπιθυηίαι τ. ἀσεβειῶν, desires for ungodly things or deeds, [[Jude.18|Ju 18]] (_DB_, iv, 532; Cremer, 523; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0794.def:
**ἄστοργος**, -ον
(στοργή, family affection, love of kindred, see: ἀγάπη)
**without natural affection**: [[Rom.1.31|Rom.1:31]], [[2Ti.3.3|2Ti.3:3]] (MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0785.def:
**ἀσπίς**, -ίδος, ἡ
[in LXX for פֶּתֶן, etc. ;]
**an asp**: [[Rom.3.13|Rom.3:13]]†
(AS)

G0711.def:
**Ἀριστόβουλος**, -ου, ὁ
(ἄριστος, βουλή, i.e. best-counselling)
**Aristobulus, a Christian**: [[Rom.16.10|Rom.16:10]]†
(AS)

G0753.def:
**ἀρχι-τέκτων**, -ονος, ὁ
(τέκτων), [in LXX: [[Isa.3.3|Isa.3:3]] (חָרָשׁ) [[Sir.38.27|Sir.38:27]] [[2Ma.2.29|2Ma.2:29]] * ;]
**a master-builder, architect**: [[1Co.3.10|1Co.3:10]] (in π. of building contractors, MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0790.def:
**ἀστατέω**, -ῶ
(ἄστατος, unstable), [in Aq.: [[Isa.58.7|Isa.58:7]] (LXX, ἄστεγος)* ;]
**to be unsettled, be homeless, lead a vagabond life **(Cremer, 738 MM, see word): [[1Co.4.11|1Co.4:11]] †
(AS)

G0728.def:
**ἀρραβών**
(T, ἀραβ-: 2Co, ll. with), -ώνος, ὁ, [in LXX: [[Gen.38.17-20|Gen.38:17-20]] (עֲרָבוֹן)* ;]
**an earnest, part payment in advance for security, a first instalment**: [[2Co.1.22; 5.5|2Co.1:22 5:5]], [[Eph.1.14|Eph.1:14]]. (The word is found in cl. and was prob. brought to Greece by the Phænicians (AR, _Eph._, l.with). It is found in π. with both spellings (see Milligan, _NTD_, 73). In M_Gr._ ἀρραβῶνα is an engagement ring; see MM, see word)†
(AS)

G0718.def:
**ἁρμόζω**
(ἁρμός), [in LXX for אמן, etc. ;]
1. to fit, join.
2. of marriage, to betroth. Mid.,
(a) **to join to oneself, marry, take to wife**; (b) to give in marriage: [[2Co.11.2|2Co.11:2]] (for this there is no direct parallel. But see M, _Pr._, 160; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0702.def:
**Ἀρέτας** (WH, Ἀρ.; _Intr._, 313), -α, ὁ,
**Aretas, an Arabian king**: [[2Co.11.32|2Co.11:32]] (Deiss., BS, 183 f., thinks the proper spelling Ἀρέθας was changed, as Schürer suggests, "by desire to Hellenise a barbaric name by assimilation to ἀρετή").†
(AS)

G0731.def:
**ἄρρητος**, -ον
(ἀ- neg., ῥητός, ῥέω), [in Sm.: [[Lev.18.23|Lev.18:23]] * ;]
1. unspoken (Hom., al.).
2. **unspeakable **(Hat., al.; frequently in Inscr.; MM, see word): [[2Co.12.4|2Co.12:4]]†
(AS)

G0725.def:
**ἁρπαγμός**, οῦ, ὁ
(ἁρπάζω);
1. prop., accusative, to the rule of its formation (Bl., § 27, 2), actively, the act of seizing, robbery (Plut., Deu Puer. Educ., p. 12A), [[Php.2.6|Php.2:6]], AV (Waterland, Works, II, 108; Cremer, 649 f.; Meyer, in l; cf. also JThS, July, 1909, April, 1911; MM, see word).
2. Passively = ἅρπαγμα ([[Ezk.22.25|Eze.22:25]], of a lion's prey, ), **a thing seized, hence, a prize**: Phi, l.with, RV (Lft., Ellic., _ICC_, in l; Donaldson, NCrat., 450 ff.; and esp. Gifford, The Incarnation, 59-71, and reff. in _DB_, ii, 835 B). The lexical data favour the active meaning, but as they also admit the possibility of the alternative, most modern expositors have accepted the latter as seeming to suit the logic of the passage better. The lexical difficulty, however, remains (MM, see word, esp. the last ref.). As to the usage of St. Paul, he seems inclined to adopt the -μα form where it is appropriate (e.g. [[Rom.11.9|Rom.11:9]], where cf. LXX; [[1Co.13.9|1Co.13:9]], 2 Co 19), and there is certainly a presumption in favour of the active meaning here from the fact that he does not use the LXX ἅρπαγμα. Suggestions looking to a fresh exegesis are given in JThS, ll with†
(AS)

G0703.def:
**ἀρετή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX, in sing.: [[Hab.3.3|Hab.3:3]], [[Zec.6.13|Zec.6:13]] (הוֹד), in pl.: [[Isa.42.8, 12; 43.21; 63.7|Isa.42:8, 12 43:21 63:7]] (תְּהִלָּה), [[Wis.4.1; 5.13; 8.7; 2.1-24|Wis.4:1 5:13 8:7 2:1-24]]; [[4Ma.2.2|4Mac.2.2]] * ;]
prop., whatever procures pre-eminent estimation for a person or thing, in Hom. any kind of conspicuous advantage. Later confined by philos. writers to intrinsic eminence-moral goodness, virtue;
(a) **of God**: [[2Pe.1.3|2Pe.1:3]]
(b) **of men**: [[Php.4.8|Php.4:8]], [[2Pe.1.5|2Pe.1:5]]; pl. (Isa, Es, ll. with), **excellencies**: [[1Pe.2.9|1Pe.2:9]] (the usage appears to be a survival of an early comprehensive sense in which the original idea is blended with the impression which it makes on others, i.e. praise, renown; see Hort, 1 Pe., 129. Deiss., BS, 95 f., thinks it means manifestations of divine power, as in current Gk. speech; cf. also MM, see word)†
(AS)

G0743.def:
**ἀρχ-άγγελος**, -ου, ὁ
(ἄρχι-, ἄγγελος),
**archangel, a chief angel**: [[1Th.4.16|1Th.4:16]], [[Jude.9|Ju 9]] (Cremer, 24; MM, see word).†
(AS)

G0795.def:
**ἀστοχέω**, -ῶ
(στόχος, a mark), [in LXX: [[Sir.7.19; 8.9|Sir.7:19 8:9]] * ;]
**to miss the mark, fail**: with genitive, [[1Ti.1.6|1Ti.1:6]] (so in π., MM, see word); before περί, [[1Ti.6.21|1Ti.6:21]], [[2Ti.2.18|2Ti.2:18]].†
(AS)

G0784.def:
**ἄ-σπιλος**, -ον
(ἀ- neg., σπῖλος) [in Sm.: [[Job.15.15|Job.15:15]] (LXX, καθαρός)* ;]
**spotless, unstained**: [[1Pe.1.19|1Pe.1:19]] metaphorically, [[1Ti.6.14|1Ti.6:14]], [[Jas.1.27|Jas.1:27]], [[2Pe.3.14|2Pe.3:14]] (for exx., see MM, see word).†
_SYN._: ἀμίαντος, ἄμωμος (AS)

G0786.def:
**ἄσπονδος**, -ον
(σπονδή, a libation);
1. without truce (Thuc.).
2. **admitting of no truce, implacable **(Dem., al.): [[2Ti.3.3|2Ti.3:3]]†
(AS)

G0750.def:
**ἀρχι-ποίμην**, -ενος, ὁ
[in Sm.: [[2Ki.3.4|4Ki.3:4]] * ;]
found on an Egyptian mummy label (Deiss., _LAE_, 97 ff.; cf. MM, see word); used by modem Greeks of tribal chiefs; chief shepherd. of Christ, [[1Pe.5.4|1Pe.5:4]]†
(AS)

G0764.def:
**ἀσεβέω**, -ῶ
(ἀσεβής), [in LXX for פָּשַׁע, רָשַׁע ;]
**to be ungodly, act profanely**: [[2Pe.2.6|2Pe.2:6]] with cogn. accusative (MM, see word), [[Jude.15|Ju 15]].†
(AS)

G0715.def:
**ἅρκος**
(Rec. (cl.) ἅρκιος), [in LXX for דֹּב ;] -ου, ὁ, ἡ,
**a bear**: [[Rev.13.2|Rev.13:2]] (This form is also found in late Inscr.; MM, see word)†
(AS)

G0717.def:
**Ἁρμαγεδών** (WH, Ἃρ Μαγεδών; Rec. Ἀρμαγεδδών, prop. = הַר מְגִדּוֹן), cf. LXX, Μαγεδών, [[2Ch.35.22|2Ch.35:22]], Μαγεδώ, [[Jdg.1.27|Jdg.1:27]] Har-Magedon (AV, Armageddon): [[Rev.16.16|Rev.16:16]] (see Swete, in l, but also Thayer, see word).†
Ἅρ,
indecl., [[Rev.16.16|Rev.16:16]], see, Ἁρμαγεδών
Μαγεδών,
**Magedon**: [[Rev.16.16|Rev.16:16]] (WH, Ἅρ M. for Ἁρμαγεδών, which see).†
(AS)
